name: La Taqueria Verdadera #2
tagline: SALSA HECHA CADA MAÑANA. NO ANTES.
address: 14722 Old Bellhaven Ave, Suite D (behind the tire place), Vista Ridge Crossing Phase II
about: My mother opened the first La Taqueria Verdadera on Bellhaven Ave in 1994. That location was reclassified in 2011 so this one is #2, we never changed the sign because the sign is painted on the wall. Salsa is made every morning by Señora Elvia, who has worked here since the beginning and does not measure anything.
announcement: WE ARE OPEN. The front phone has not worked since Tuesday so if you need us please call the cell 209-555-0148 and let it ring, my son is fixing the other one. No lengua on Mondays becuase the delivery comes Tuesday morning. Thank you for your patience.
promos: FREE EGG ROLL OVER $35 — ASK OR YOU WILL NOT GET IT

reviews.name: Ruben C.
reviews.text: I have been coming here since the Bellhaven location and I will say the same thing I have said for twenty years, the salsa roja is the best in this county and it is not close. My kids grew up on the asada. Every taco arrives correct.

reviews.name: Danielle W.
reviews.text: There is nowhere to park. The tire place takes all of it and one of their guys looked at me.

reviews.name: Ofelia M.
reviews.text: They charged me $1.15 for no onions and then wrote my name on a list by the register. I have made my peace with the list.

reviews.name: Trevor A.
reviews.text: Quesadilla did not fit in the bag or on my table. Had to eat it on the counter like a person. Would order again.

reviews.name: Sandra L.
reviews.text: I called about a catering order and a woman answered and said the phone was broken and hung up. Different restaurant entirely I think.

reviews.name: Hector P.
reviews.text: Ask for the consomé. Ask for it every time. That is all.

Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out white hotspot on the meat, hard black shadow thrown behind the plate. Shot from too close and slightly above, the subject not centred, a squeeze bottle of salsa and a stack of napkins at the edge of frame. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, sensor noise. Square crop. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no watermarks, no hands, no people.
